Honeywell offers industry leading gas control, measurement and analysis equipment to gas utilities
and other users around the world.

Innovative control technology for the automation of gas, industrial, compressor systems and special
applications. Individual hardware and software solutions from a single source.

meters such as rotary meters as well as flow meters such as turbine meters.

## Together, we build efficient, optimised, and sustainable solutions

For 80 years, Kamstrup has striven to make every measurement matter. Through collaboration and
innovation, we develop smart metering solutions that protect water, secure energy, and optimise
performance while reducing costs.

By empowering utilities and building performance managers to act with confidence, not guesswork, we
take operational efficiency and resource management beyond today's standards.

**We Make What You Measure Matter**

[About Kamstrup][58]
Watch video

## Stories from our customers 

Explore our case stories and discover how, together with our customers, we have pushed the
boundaries of modern metering through innovation and dedication. 
[Customer references][59]

#### Reversing water loss in a rural municipality

With a 51% water loss equivalent to 750 million litres annually, Oneida was in serious trouble.
However, despite topographical challenges and limited resources, Kamstrup quickly helped the
municipality bounce back and become a source of inspiration for other utilities. 
][60]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW4]

#### Solrød Forsyning lowers return temperature with RTO

Using Kamstrup's Return Temperature Optimizer (RTO), Solrød Forsyning gets help identifying errors
in both old and new heating installations thus optimising the district heating network and
increasing customer satisfaction. 
][61]
[
[2024-11-20_Front page_case pictures_NEW8]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open

# [Discover the Power of Choice]
# 

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

## About Cura

We’re Cura Energy. We are a purpose-led business specialising in smart energy and building solutions
for complex and multi-site estates.

— CURA ENERGY

Since 2011, we have helped many of Britain’s biggest – and most carbon-conscious businesses –
including the UK’s leading retail brands - accelerate the path to Net Zero carbon. We use a
combination of data-driven energy solutions and building technologies to solve climate and energy
transition challenges.
 
We do things differently. We take a strategy first approach to every project. Our start point is to
understand the bigger picture whether it’s your ESG goals or operational and compliance challenges.
We offer nationwide coverage to the most demanding sectors including major retail brands,
healthcare, multi-tenancy workplace, finance and large government estates.
 
Cura is proud to be vendor agnostic. Our technology portfolio includes digital and hardware
solutions from global manufacturers including Trend, Siemens, Priva and many others.

Established in 2011
A market leader for energy savings

Providing value driven ideas and innovation

With you all the way, from concept to completion

We see ourselves as your guardian for energy efficiency and reduction, providing a range of service

Our team of experts are based in Kent and have the capability to operate nationwide and across
Europe.

With ongoing advancements in new technology, energy products and the various systems available

## About Cura

We’re Cura Energy. We are a purpose-led business specialising in smart energy and building solutions
for complex and multi-site estates.

— CURA ENERGY

Since 2011, we have helped many of Britain’s biggest – and most carbon-conscious businesses –
including the UK’s leading retail brands - accelerate the path to Net Zero carbon. We use a
combination of data-driven energy solutions and building technologies to solve climate and energy
transition challenges.
 
We do things differently. We take a strategy first approach to every project. Our start point is to
understand the bigger picture whether it’s your ESG goals or operational and compliance challenges.
We offer nationwide coverage to the most demanding sectors including major retail brands,
healthcare, multi-tenancy workplace, finance and large government estates.
 
Cura is proud to be vendor agnostic. Our technology portfolio includes digital and hardware
solutions from global manufacturers including Trend, Siemens, Priva and many others.

Established in 2011
A market leader for energy savings

Providing value driven ideas and innovation

With you all the way, from concept to completion

“Reducing energy use makes perfect business sense. It saves money, enhances corporate reputation and
helps everyone in the fight against climate change” — Carbon Trust
“UK businesses could save approximately £23 billion per year by making simple changes to use
resources more efficiently” — DEFRA
“It is fact, that companies can save up to 30% on their bills with the implementation of an energy
metering system” — Cura Energy

## Services

We will never just come in, install and then go - that’s never been the Cura Energy way and never
will be.

— OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

We see ourselves as your guardian for energy efficiency and reduction, providing a range of service
packages which can be tailored to meet client requirements.

Our team of experts are based in Kent and have the capability to operate nationwide and across
Europe.

With ongoing advancements in new technology, energy products and the various systems available
within the marketplace we make it our role to be armed with the latest up to date information and be
at the forefront of instigating change.

Our clients can be confident that our experience of different product applications allows us to
tailor project processes, installation programmes, deliver on agreed targets and act as an extension
to your business.

We do evolution every day, what we really aspire to is bringing revolution to our industry and you
our client.

Our Energy Monitoring Installation & Validation service delivers an end-to-end solution for precise
and dependable sub-metering and energy data insights.

We oversee complete metering installations and perform in-depth validations of existing systems to
ensure accuracy and reliability. This empowers businesses to make data-driven decisions, establish
baselines, track energy project performance and swiftly identify high-consumption areas.

Meters can also support accurate tenant billing in multi-tenanted properties and provide reliable
data for consumption monitoring across different zones or assets within a building. Our service
drives greater transparency, ensures compliance and improves cost-efficiency in energy management.
It also supports stronger relationships between operators, landlords and tenants while maximising
return on investment for asset owners and managers.

Completing our portfolio of turnkey services is LiveEye, our advanced energy management platform.
LiveEye provides comprehensive insights into your energy usage including consumption rates, sources,
functional use, weather impact, and more.

Cura Energy is a leading system integrator providing a wide range of BeMS packages.

We are proud to be an approved supplier and installer of the following BeMS system houses, Siemens,
Priva, RDM and Trend.

Whether your business is local, national or global, we can help keep your workspace energy efficient
through effective design, manufacture, engineering and commissioning, irrespective of project size.
Our solutions are 100% energy focused and tailored to suit your needs, keeping systems easy to
operate, without compromising conditions or the operational performance of your building.

Of course not all BEMS systems need to be created from scratch. We can improve and refurbish
existing ones, integrating them seamlessly and our skilled teams can create a range of energy saving
software for new and existing systems.

We know energy reduction and compliance is a constant challenge as businesses face tougher penalties
for not meeting regulatory commitments.

Aligning ourselves with the best energy reduction products available, we can review your installed
metering and management systems and advise on what additional actions can further reduce energy
consumption.

We have a range of solutions and services to suit with products from lighting and HVAC to renewable
technologies. One of our latest products, developed by Cura Energy is Live eye™ which enables Store
Managers, Energy managers and stakeholders to review gas, electricity and water usage live - in real
time. Live eye™ can relay energy readings to you whilst you are on the go to web enabled devices
such as smartphones or tablets wherever you may be in the workspace.

Contact us to learn more about how our services, technology, products and initiatives can help
reduce your projects energy consumption.

We offer different service level packages for the on-going maintenance of your metering, building
management systems and energy reduction products.

Our structured aftercare service ensures that new or existing systems operate as intended and
continue to operate efficiently whether via a preventative or reactive maintenance visit.

We use the latest web-enabled technology to monitor how systems are operating, quickly identifying
any issues so they can be resolved remotely or on-site, either by Cura engineers or your own
in-house team.

Our Cura Engineers provide national coverage, who are multi skilled to investigate all issues from a
completely holistic approach, providing you with true long term value.

Our Bureau Facility operates 365 days a year with a proactive support helpdesk contactable 24 hours
a day, seven days a week.

## Take Control Of Your Energy Costs

The [Emporia Home Energy Management Platform][81] is a smart, automated solution that helps you save
on energy costs. It works seamlessly in the background to monitor energy usage in real-time, down to
individual circuits and appliances, and automatically adjusts connected devices to optimize
electricity use and maximize savings.

[Shop All Products][82]

## Award-Winning Products

### Classic EV Charger

Named the “Best Smart EV Home Charger” by MotorTrend, the “Best Overall Home EV Charger of 2024” by
Good Housekeeping, and a “Best Home Charger” by NYTimes Wirecutter, the Classic is the proven choice
for reliable and intelligent charging.

[Learn More][83]
[Classic EV Charger]

### Pro EV Charger

The Emporia Pro EV Charger makes powerful automated Level 2 charging possible for almost any home.
Thanks to PowerSmart technology, you can charge your EV up to 9 times faster than a level 1 charger
using your existing electrical panel and save thousands on electrical upgrades.

[Learn More][84]
[Pro EV Charger]

### Vue Energy Monitor

The Emporia Vue Home Energy Monitor is your gateway to smarter energy management, and the best way
to identify expensive energy hogs quickly. Pair with our Smart Plugs, EV Chargers, and other
connected devices to unlock full home automation and maximize your monthly savings.

### Energy/Carbon Reduction

Frontline Energy is an energy management solution provider that was founded in 2011 with a goal to
provide an end-to-end maintenance and energy management solution for the built environment. We
design tailored solutions that focus on enhancing business performance and reducing running costs
for our customers. We understand the importance of energy and take it as our responsibility to
advise on ways to minimize energy use, costs, and environmental impact.

[Learn More][40]
[Frontline Energy workers]
[Grey dots]

### Energy Innovation

We implement and service energy solutions and technologies that reduce carbon emissions and improve
cost efficiencies, enhancing the business of our customers and the lives of end users.

#### Cost-efficiency

Cleaner, more efficient means of powering and heating residential and commercial buildings will help
to reduce consumer energy bills and the costs associated with disposing the waste created from its
generation.

#### Climate Change

Identifying new energy technologies or improving efficiencies of current heating solutions will help
reduce the level of carbon emissions into the environment that lead to climate change.

#### Reduced Air Pollution

Finding energy alternatives to fossil fuels to heat and power our homes and businesses will lower
emissions of harmful gases like carbon dioxide.

#### Reliability

With global energy requirements increasing, energy innovation is concerned with identifying means of
energy production that are reliable and dependable enough to meet the needs of a growing population,
and which are cleaner to generate and store.

## A History of Submetering Success

Founded in 1983, Guardian is a leading provider of comprehensive utility cost recovery services. We
specialize in submeter system design, installation, data acquisition, utility billing, collections,
and overall utility management. With nearly four decades of experience, we are committed to
delivering exceptional customer service and reliable solutions across a wide range of properties,
including apartments, condominiums, offices, retail spaces, manufactured housing, and marinas.


Our core focus is helping property owners and managers efficiently recover utility costs through
advanced submetering technologies. Backed by an in-house team of expert programmers and application
engineers, Guardian works closely with clients to enhance net operating income, increase property
value, and promote sustainability through water and energy conservation.

[Read More][13]

## Tailored Solutions for Every Property Type

With nearly four decades of experience, we are committed to delivering exceptional customer service

How it Works

## How Submetering Works

[iStock-629248388.jpg]

### Install

###### A wireless meter is installed for each unit, and a central submeter data collector (about the
###### size of a router) is placed in a mechanical room, closet, or leasing office. For flexibility,
###### pre-programmed, client-installed submeter kits are also available. This setup ensures
###### accurate tracking of individual unit usage.
######  

[moeny_edited.png]

1

### Connect

###### The central data collector connects to the Guardian network using an internet connection
###### provided by the property. For smaller properties that lack a leasing office or clubhouse, we
###### offer 3G and manual read options. Meter readings are sent in real-time, ensuring your
###### property is always up to date on usage data.
###### 
######  

[Wireless Water Submetering]

2

### Bill

###### Each resident receives a monthly utility bill based on their individual submetered usage,
###### charged at the same rates used by the local utility provider. We offer regulatory support to
###### ensure your property’s billing program complies with local rules and regulations, so you stay
###### compliant without hassle.
######  

[invoice_edited.png]

3

### Collect

###### You can choose to manage collections in-house or outsource to Guardian. Our website portal
###### makes it easy to track utility payments, monitor for leaks or usage spikes, and receive
###### notifications. It also integrates with property management software like Yardi, OneSite,
###### AppFolio, Entrata and RentManager.

[HiRes_clipped_rev_1 (1)_edited.png]

4

[Request Proposal][20]
[Neighborhood]

## Things Our Clients Say:

> "I wanted to you to let you know how pleased I am with your service at my building in Seattle.
> Previously, I had been paying all water, sewer and garbage bill for the units. Since the units
> were not individually metered, I had no way of knowing how much each tenant was using.
>  Immediately after installation, the resident billing services began.   I still pay the master
> bill to Seattle Public Utility, but my residents send me their portion of the utility usage based
> on the submetering.  Within four months the system has paid for itself."

Mary Dombrowski

Bainbridge Island, Washington

###### We provide our submetering & utility billing services to over 4,900 real estate investors,
###### developers and property management companies in 46 states.

How it Works

## How Submetering Works

[iStock-629248388.jpg]

### Install

###### A wireless meter is installed for each unit, and a central submeter data collector (about the
###### size of a router) is placed in a mechanical room, closet, or leasing office. For flexibility,
###### pre-programmed, client-installed submeter kits are also available. This setup ensures
###### accurate tracking of individual unit usage.
######  

[moeny_edited.png]

1

### Connect

###### The central data collector connects to the Guardian network using an internet connection
###### provided by the property. For smaller properties that lack a leasing office or clubhouse, we
###### offer 3G and manual read options. Meter readings are sent in real-time, ensuring your
###### property is always up to date on usage data.
###### 
######  

[Wireless Water Submetering]

2

### Bill

###### Each resident receives a monthly utility bill based on their individual submetered usage,
###### charged at the same rates used by the local utility provider. We offer regulatory support to
###### ensure your property’s billing program complies with local rules and regulations, so you stay
###### compliant without hassle.
######  

[invoice_edited.png]

3

### Collect

###### You can choose to manage collections in-house or outsource to Guardian. Our website portal
###### makes it easy to track utility payments, monitor for leaks or usage spikes, and receive
###### notifications. It also integrates with property management software like Yardi, OneSite,
###### AppFolio, Entrata and RentManager.

[HiRes_clipped_rev_1 (1)_edited.png]

4

Mary Dombrowski
